Janelle Ho: Heads up  candidate Ahmed Karim is observant and needs interview windows outside of prayer times next Wed (June 2). He asked for any slot between 1:00pm1:45pm PT or 3:30pm 5:00pm PT. Prefer a single 45min panel in the afternoon. Also asked about wheelchair accessibility and a travel subsidy for train.

Marcus Green: I can do 3:30pm PT. Prefer to keep it remote but happy to come onsite if needed.

Priya Reddy: Hiring manager here  3:30pm PT works for me. Can we make it a 45min focused loop: 3:30-4:15, tech + culture wrap?

Janelle Ho: Ok locking 3:30-4:15pm PT. Candidate prefers remote; we'll offer on-site Quiet Room E as fallback. Marcus, Priya, and Sheila (swe) will be the panel.

Facilities Bot: Accessibility note: Building lobby and Quiet Room E are wheelchair accessible. Guest badge and elevator code prebooked for visitors.

Janelle Ho: I'll pre-approve travel subsidy up to $100 for train. Recruiter please collect receipt and submit with code "CARE-INTERVIEW" to Expensify. Note: approval must be logged before reimbursement.

Candidate - Ahmed: Thanks all  3:30pm PT works. I appreciate the accessibility confirmation and the travel help. I'll send ticket to the recruiter after I book.

Marcus Green: Can someone add a short 2-line prep note for the candidate about scope and what to expect? Also include Zoom + backup Meet links.

Janelle Ho: Will do. Calendar invite will include Zoom + Meet, rubric, and the accessibility note. Prep snippet: "45min loop 1: 30min technical/system design; 15min culture + Qs. We use a shared Google Doc for whiteboarding."

Priya Reddy: No special setup needed. Thanks for accommodating Ahmed's timing.

Janelle Ho: Recruiter, please DM Ahmed the expense flow and tag people-ops receipts when he uploads. I'll CC facilities for badge pickup instructions. Thanks team! :pray:
